    Questions before you visit

    CRE8 @ Novva is inside Novva Industrial Park, Sungai Buaya, Serendah. It is accessible today via the Sungai Buaya Interchange on the E1 North–South Expressway.

    SPA prices start from RM 9,985,000 for Type A, RM 10,985,000 for Type B and RM 11,000,000 for Type C (corner). The full lot-by-lot price chart is shown above. Prices are subject to availability and change, so contact us for the latest status.

    Type A is a 0.99-acre intermediate lot with 22,833 sq ft built-up. Type B is an intermediate lot of 1.20–1.24 acres with 25,865 sq ft built-up and side ramps. Type C is a corner lot of 1.19–1.25 acres with 25,844 sq ft built-up.

    The planned connection within Novva Industrial Park towards Bukit Beruntung Interchange is targeted for Q1 2028. It is based on the master plan and subject to infrastructure implementation and authority / developer progress.

    CRE8 Development Sdn Bhd, a subsidiary of Legacy Maker Berhad.

    None at all. The viewing is free and private. Come see the site, ask every question you have, and decide in your own time.
